def factor_signed_path_efficiency_soft_confirmation(df):
    """Measure persistent directional phases with softened directional confirmation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    net_move = close - close.shift(126)
    path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(126, min_periods=126).sum()
    efficiency = net_move / path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    recent_net_move = close - close.shift(63)
    recent_path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum()
    recent_efficiency = recent_net_move / recent_path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    recent_magnitude = np.sqrt(recent_efficiency.abs().clip(lower=0.0))
    directional_agreement = np.tanh(5.0 * efficiency * recent_efficiency)
    confirmation_weight = 1.0 + 0.25 * recent_magnitude * directional_agreement
    signal = efficiency * confirmation_weight
    df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_soft_confirmation"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_soft_confirmation"]
